treatments.title: Hands-on therapy
treatments.summary: Precise hands-on work to improve your mobility and function.
treatments.description: Manual techniques aimed at improving mobility, reducing pain and optimising musculoskeletal function.

treatments.title: Musculoskeletal ultrasound
treatments.summary: See more to understand better. A tool that complements your clinical assessment.
treatments.description: An assessment tool that shows muscles, tendons, ligaments and other structures in real time to complement the clinical evaluation and guide treatment.

treatments.title: Shockwave therapy
treatments.summary: Acoustic waves applied to tissue to support its functional recovery.
treatments.description: Application of acoustic waves to musculoskeletal tissue to stimulate biological processes, improve tissue capacity and support functional recovery.

treatments.title: Ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrolysis
treatments.summary: A localised approach to injured tissue, guided by ultrasound.
treatments.description: An ultrasound-guided invasive technique using an electrical current to support the regenerative response and recovery of injured tissue.

treatments.title: Percutaneous neuromodulation
treatments.summary: Targeted stimulation of neuromuscular structures to modulate pain.
treatments.description: A technique using electrical stimulation through needles, directed at neuromuscular structures to modulate pain and improve neuromuscular function.

treatments.title: Dry needling
treatments.summary: A specific technique for muscle points that may be related to your symptoms.
treatments.description: An invasive technique using needles on specific muscle points to reduce pain, normalise tone and improve muscle function.

treatments.title: Therapeutic massage
treatments.summary: Therapeutic massage to support tissue mobility and muscle recovery.
treatments.description: Massage techniques aimed at improving tissue mobility, supporting circulation and facilitating muscle recovery.

treatments.title: Diathermy
treatments.summary: Radiofrequency with a controlled thermal effect, adapted to your treatment.
treatments.description: Radiofrequency therapy that creates a controlled thermal effect in tissue, supporting circulation, tissue metabolism and functional recovery.

recovery.label: We listen
recovery.subtitle: Initial assessment
recovery.title: We start with your story, not a technique.
recovery.text: We talk about your symptoms, your history and what you want to recover. Clinical examination helps us understand how you move and what you need.

recovery.label: We understand
recovery.subtitle: Study and goals
recovery.title: Understand what is happening. Know where we are going.
recovery.text: When indicated, ultrasound complements the assessment. We explain what we observe and agree concrete, realistic goals with you.

recovery.label: We work on it
recovery.subtitle: Personal treatment
recovery.title: A treatment that makes sense for you.
recovery.text: We choose techniques based on your assessment, preferences and progress. We explain every step and adapt the work to your tolerance and daily life.

recovery.label: We support you
recovery.subtitle: Follow-up
recovery.title: Recovery does not end when you leave the clinic.
recovery.text: We review your progress and adapt the plan when needed. The goal is for you to understand your process and move again with more independence and confidence.

faq.question: Do I need to know which treatment I need?
faq.answer: No. At the first visit we talk about what is happening and assess you. We then explain the options and agree the next steps with you.

faq.question: Do you only see people who do sport?
faq.answer: No. Physiotherapy also supports everyday aches and pains. Whether you want to train, walk, work or move more comfortably, we start with your case.

faq.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
faq.answer: Comfortable clothing and, if you have them, reports or tests related to your reason for visiting. You can discuss your history and medication with the professional during the assessment.

faq.question: Does an enquiry confirm an appointment?
faq.answer: An enquiry is the first contact. The clinic must confirm availability, duration and price with you before booking. You do not need to pay to request information.

faq.question: Why is there a form for new patients?
faq.answer: It helps us prepare for the first conversation. It includes initial questions and consent about the data. This version is a demonstration: use fictional information; the form is not saved and does not create a real appointment.
